source: ATP: Jeff Sackmann match CSVs via the public mirror bornamilkovic/ATP-Matches (data/atp_matches_2015..2024.csv — the original JeffSackmann/tennis_atp repo was deleted by its owner; mirror schema verified Sackmann-verbatim), extended 2025-2026 via Aneeshers/tennis-sackmann-archive (same upstream; its 2024 file is md5-identical to the bornamilkovic file). ATP doubles: Sackmann atp_matches_doubles_2015..2020 via the same archive mirror. WTA: tennis-data.co.uk archive format via fmmarino1/wta-tennis (wta.csv, 2015+)

params.note: priced model = overall Elo per tour; surface ratings carried for reporting (a slate entry carries no surface)

backtest.protocol: walk-forward (Elo from prior matches only; naive = relative running career win rate, 4-match 0.5 prior)

surface_backtest.protocol: walk-forward; surface rating when both players have >=5 matches on the surface, else the overall rating. DIAGNOSTIC — the priced model is the overall Elo (a slate entry carries no surface)

atp.window: 2015-2026 (2015-2024 bornamilkovic mirror; 2025-2026 Sackmann archive mirror, 2024 file md5-identical across both)

doubles.corpus: Sackmann atp_matches_doubles 2015-2020 via Aneeshers/tennis-sackmann-archive (the archive's doubles years end at 2020; no WTA doubles files exist in either mirror)
doubles.model: pair-keyed Elo, K=32; debut seed = mean of the members' individual doubles Elo (1500 for a member with no doubles history)

backtest.protocol: walk-forward (pair Elo from prior pair matches only; debut pairs seeded by the members' individual doubles Elo mean; naive = relative running pair win rate, 4-match 0.5 prior)

doubles.status: PASSED — pair ratings merged into the ATP elo dict

backtest.protocol: walk-forward (Elo from prior matches only; naive = relative running career win rate, 4-match 0.5 prior)

surface_backtest.protocol: walk-forward; surface rating when both players have >=5 matches on the surface, else the overall rating. DIAGNOSTIC — the priced model is the overall Elo (a slate entry carries no surface)

wta.window: 2015+ (archive runs current; the 2026-10-27 pull is row-identical to the shipped fit's corpus — n=25,526, max date 2026-04-12)
